mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, display_name, phone, avatar_url, login_count, last_login_time FROM sys_user WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY last_login_time DESC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS login_count FROM login_log GROUP BY user_id ) l ON u.user_id = l.user_id SET u.login_count = IFNULL(l.login_count, 0)
